Nithari Case Convict Surendra Koli Dies by Suicide in Haridwar

Surendra Koli, who was convicted in the Nithari killings case, has died by suicide in Haridwar. He was found hanging in a tea shop. Koli was convicted for the kidnapping, rape, and murder of several children in Noida's Nithari village. The case involved the discovery of children's skeletal remains in a drain near his residence. The Nithari case is described as one of the most horrific in the region.
